# pve_sdn_zone_evpn (Resource)

Manages an EVPN SDN zone (`/cluster/sdn/zones`, type `evpn`) built on a BGP/EVPN controller. Creating, updating, or deleting a zone only changes the pending SDN configuration; run the `pve_sdn_apply` action to apply it to the running configuration. Changing `zone` forces recreation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage an EVPN SDN zone on a BGP/EVPN controller.
resource "pve_sdn_zone_evpn" "zone1" {
  zone       = "zone1"
  controller = "ctrl1"

  vrf_vxlan                  = 100
  advertise_subnets          = true
  exitnodes                  = "pve1,pve2"
  exitnodes_primary          = "pve1"
  rt_import                  = "65000:100"
  secondary_controllers      = ["ctrl2"]
  disable_arp_nd_suppression = false

  nodes = "pve1,pve2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) The SDN zone object identifier (2 to 8 characters, starting with a letter). Changing this value forces recreation.

### Optional

- `advertise_subnets` (Boolean) Advertise IP prefixes (Type-5 routes) instead of MAC/IP pairs (Type-2 routes) (PVE `advertise-subnets`).
- `controller` (String) ID of the primary BGP/EVPN controller (PVE `controller`) for this zone, for example a `pve_sdn_controller` of type `evpn`.
- `dhcp` (String) Name of the DHCP server backend for this zone (PVE `dhcp`). Must be one of: `dnsmasq`.
- `disable_arp_nd_suppression` (Boolean) Suppress IPv4 ARP and IPv6 Neighbour Discovery messages (PVE `disable-arp-nd-suppression`).
- `dns` (String) ID of the DNS API server (PVE `dns`) for this zone.
- `dnszone` (String) DNS domain zone for this zone (PVE `dnszone`), for example `mydomain.com`.
- `exitnodes` (String) Comma-separated list of cluster node names (PVE `pve-node-list`) that act as exit nodes routing EVPN traffic to the outside, for example `pve1,pve2`.
- `exitnodes_local_routing` (Boolean) Create routes on the exit nodes so they can connect to EVPN guests directly (PVE `exitnodes-local-routing`).
- `exitnodes_primary` (String) Cluster node name (PVE `pve-node`) that traffic is forced through first, e.g. `pve1`.
- `ipam` (String) ID of the IPAM (PVE `ipam`) managing IP addresses in this zone, for example `pve`.
- `mac` (String) Anycast logical router MAC address (PVE `mac-addr`) for this zone, for example `AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF`.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU of the zone (PVE `mtu`), used for the created VNet bridges.
- `nodes` (String) Comma-separated list of cluster node names where this zone should be created (PVE `pve-node-list`), for example `pve1,pve2`.
- `reversedns` (String) ID of the reverse DNS server (PVE `reversedns`) for this zone.
- `rt_import` (String) Comma-separated list of Route Targets (PVE `pve-sdn-bgp-rt-list`) imported into the VRF of this zone via BGP, for example `65000:100`.
- `secondary_controllers` (List of String) Additional controller IDs (PVE `secondary-controllers`) peering with the primary controller.
- `vrf_vxlan` (Number) VNI for the zone VRF (PVE `vrf-vxlan`). Must be between 1 and 16777215.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) The read-only SDN configuration revision (PVE `digest`) of the zone section.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Import a PVE SDN zone by its zone identifier.
terraform import pve_sdn_zone_evpn.zone1 "zone1"
```
